instruction: Enable Windows Sticky Keys as a motor accessibility aid and keep it enabled throughout the task. The provided bank statement PDF is already open in Chrome. Find the maximum investigation period mentioned for a complaint or question, then save only the investigation period in a text file named `investigationPeriod.txt` on the Desktop.
gt_steps: Keep Sticky Keys enabled throughout the task.
Read the bank statement PDF already open in Chrome.
Locate the section describing complaints or questions about electronic transfers.
Identify the maximum investigation period as 90 days.
Save the file as `investigationPeriod.txt` on the Desktop.
Leave the saved file on the Desktop.

result.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$flags=[int](Get-ItemPropertyValue -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Accessibility\StickyKeys' -Name 'Flags' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue); if (($flags -band 1) -eq 1) { Write-Output 'STICKY_KEYS_ENABLED' } else { Write-Output 'STICKY_KEYS_DISABLED' }"
